supplementaryStates.preconditionAndVisualRule: Illustrative fixture ownedCount=0, not the user account; exact verified ground/boundary only, no unowned architecture or studio shadow.
Illustrative fixture with only ildu.sarangchae-site; no architecture or shadow. Do not generalize this zero-mesh rule to other buildings first stages.
Actual evaluator reports missing learning evidence; show the actual named activity, keep owned art, invent no lesson or completion.
Eligibility passes, no transaction committed; next-stage preview stays distinct from actual ownership.
Actual eligible stage only; display stage, current-to-next comparison, cost and balance only after the owning service supplies them.
Cancel leaves map focus, ownership and resources unchanged.
Actual evaluator reports shortfall; retain current stage and explain the actual earning path; no invented price, deficit or balance.
Transaction pending; suppress repeat purchase, early success and unconfirmed balance changes.
Only after committed result; exact selected R16, actual ledger result; reveal is presentation of a committed change.
Reconcile transaction outcome before retry; retain owned art and prevent duplicate debit or reward.
Preserve map focus and selected building after activity; show only actual updated ownership and next action.
Read or replay without repurchase or duplicate credit; newly available story facts can be presented once.
Available authored fact can be read in accessible yard/journal or translated picture summary; no purchase/proficiency/Korean-answer gate.
Retain stage label and navigation, allow retry, never substitute regenerated architecture or imply progress loss.
Stable reveal and readable text convey the same committed result; camera/cloud movement carries no essential meaning.
Separate QA fixture at narrow viewport and enlarged text; preserve actual stage, cost explanation and CTA; do not compress German.

title.en: Foundation 1 · First sounds and letter positions

foundationBandMetadata.teachingFocusKo: 기본 모음과 첫자리 ㅇ, 좌우·위아래 음절 배치를 시범 후 연습

teachingFocus.ko: 기본 모음과 첫자리 ㅇ, 좌우·위아래 음절 배치를 시범 후 연습
teachingFocus.en: Practise basic vowels, initial ㅇ and the placement of letters in syllable blocks after a demonstration.
teachingFocus.de: Übe nach einer Demonstration Grundvokale, anlautendes ㅇ und die Anordnung der Buchstaben im Silbenblock.

title.en: Foundation 2 · Consonant pieces and familiar words

foundationBandMetadata.teachingFocusKo: 가르친 자음·모음 결합과 뜻을 배운 낱말의 연결

teachingFocus.ko: 가르친 자음·모음 결합과 뜻을 배운 낱말의 연결
teachingFocus.en: Combine taught consonants and vowels and connect familiar words with meanings already introduced.
teachingFocus.de: Verbinde eingeführte Konsonanten und Vokale und ordne bekannte Wörter ihren bereits eingeführten Bedeutungen zu.

title.en: Foundation 3 · Sound contrasts and first final consonants

foundationBandMetadata.teachingFocusKo: 새 소리를 하나씩 가르친 뒤 대비하고 첫 받침의 자리 확인

teachingFocus.ko: 새 소리를 하나씩 가르친 뒤 대비하고 첫 받침의 자리 확인
teachingFocus.en: Introduce new sounds one at a time, then compare them and practise the position of the first final consonants.
teachingFocus.de: Führe neue Laute einzeln ein, vergleiche sie anschließend und übe die Position erster Endkonsonanten.

title.en: Foundation 4 · End sounds, connected reading and input
title.de: Einstieg 4 · Endlaute, verbundenes Lesen und Eingabe

teachingFocus.en: Practise final sounds and sound linking in familiar expressions, then enter and correct those expressions.
teachingFocus.de: Übe Endlaute und Lautverbindungen in bekannten Ausdrücken und gib diese Ausdrücke ein oder korrigiere sie.

crossContractIssues.descriptionKo: 사랑채 첫 단계 스냅샷은 A1 누적 4단원을 요구한다. 입문1~4와의 공정 지급 연결은 조정 전이며 이 파일은 요구 조건을 바꾸지 않는다.
BUILDING_HOOKS.csv의 33개 actual_stage_id는 비어 있다. 중간 공정은 목업용 대표 선택이지 발동 공정 승인이 아니다.
첨부의 Restoration 0/36과 코인 0은 시각 참고값이다. R16 전체는128공정이며 실제 카운터 정의·잔액 확인 전 숫자를 복사하지 않는다.
현재 확인된 분리 전경·그림자는 사랑채 16공정뿐이다. 다른 10동 전체 투명 전달 완료를 증명하지 못한다.
